content.short: Phala Network is a decentralized AI compute cloud on Ethereum providing private execution via TEE hardware.
content.description:
Phala Network is an innovative decentralized cloud computing platform designed to provide a secure and confidential execution layer for Web3 AI and privacy-sensitive applications. By utilizing Trusted Execution Environments (TEE)—secure hardware enclaves—the network enables developers to process sensitive data without ever exposing it to the underlying infrastructure or the internet. This approach ensures total data privacy while maintaining high-performance compute capabilities across a globally distributed network.

Originally a Polkadot parachain, Phala has evolved into a high-throughput Ethereum Layer 2 to better serve the growing demand for verifiable and private AI inference. The network is powered by the $PHA token, which facilitates compute resource allocation, staking, and decentralized governance. By providing a robust and scalable framework for confidential computation, Phala Network is empowering the next generation of builders to create more secure and privacy-centric decentralized applications for the global economy.
